text:
Elisabeth: Quick FYI 1 /v1/embeddings doc shows the response example with "vector": [...], but our runtime and clients return "embedding": [floats]. Broke the Go example in examples_test.go.

Samir: Can you paste the failing log?

Elisabeth: From CI: ```
FAIL: examples_test.go:42: missing field "vector"
response body:
{
  "model": "text-embedding-001",
  "usage": { "prompt_tokens": 12 },
  "embedding": [0.001, 0.23, ...]
}
```

Morgan: Looks like the OpenAPI YAML still declares components/schemas/EmbeddingResponse with "vector". Our docs generator pulled that into the examples.

Kevin: SDKs were already moved to "embedding" last week. Docs regen lagged behind.

Elisabeth: I opened a tiny PR that updates the example payloads and all SDK snippets (Go/Python) to use "embedding" and added a short note in migration.md about the key rename: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/418

Samir: Please also add a single-line mention in the breaking-changes section that key names changed for embeddings so users parsing by literal keys are aware.

Morgan: I'll add a docs-build unit test that verifies example responses match the canonical runtime shape and add a case for empty arrays.

Kevin: Left inline comments on PR 418 (wording + an extra test for zero-length embeddings). Once addressed I'm happy to approve. @docs-bot can we get a preview?

docs-bot: preview build started for PR 418  https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/418  logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/7921 :white_check_mark:

Elisabeth: Addressed comments, updated Go snippet: changed `resp.Vector` -> `resp.Embedding`, updated JSON marshal example and curl sample.

Samir: Approved. One more follow-up: the generate endpoint examples use both `model` and `model_id` in different places. Can we standardize on `model` in examples and add a small redirect note for `model_id`? Some external integrations still copy the old examples.

Morgan: Good catch, I'll grep the repo and replace `model_id` -> `model` in examples and add a short note in the migration guide.

Kevin: After merge let's cut a micro docs release so downstream marketplaces and partners pick up the fixes quickly.

Elisabeth: Will merge once the preview is green. Thanks team :thumbsup:
